'''Oscar Denis Sánchez''' (born 2 October 1946, in [[Concepción, Paraguay|Concepción]]) is a [[Paraguay]]an politician and former [[Vice President of Paraguay|Vice President]]. He was elected in June 2012.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|last=S.A|first=Grupo JBB Servicios|title=Perfil de Óscar Denis, exvicepresidente desaparecido presumiblemente en manos del EPP|url=http://www.trece.com.py/actualidad/quien-es-oscar-denis|access-date=2020-09-12|website=Trece|date=9 September 2020 |language=es}}</ref> Upon his election he was Senator in the [[Senate of Paraguay]].

==Information==
Previously he was the governor of [[Concepción Department (Paraguay)|Concepción Department]] 1993–1998 and a member of the [[Chamber of Deputies of Paraguay|Chamber of Deputies]] 1998–2003. He is a chemist by profession.<ref name=":0" />

== 2020 kidnapping ==
Denis was kidnapped along with one of his employees, on 9&nbsp;September 2020 near Concepción, not far from the site where the Paraguayan army had dismantled a [[Paraguayan People’s Army]] (EPP) training area a week before. On 11&nbsp;September, it was officially revealed that this organization was responsible for the abductions.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Paraguay: el gobierno confirmó que el grupo EPP está detrás del secuestro del ex vicepresidente Denis|trans-title=Paraguay: the government confirmed that the EPP group is behind the kidnapping of former Vice President Denis|last=Filas|first=Cecilia|url=https://www.cronista.com/internacionales/Paraguay-el-gobierno-confirmo-que-el-grupo-EPP-esta-detras-del-secuestro-del-ex-vicepresidente-Denis-20200911-0043.html|access-date=12 September 2020|website=El Cronista|date=11 September 2020 |language=es-ES}}</ref> {{As of|2026|2}}, Denis's fate is unknown.
